description: This source file defines the 'HtmlSanitizer' class within the SuiteCRM namespace, which provides methods for sanitizing HTML content, preventing XSS vulnerabilities, and customizing HTML purification configurations.

classes.name: HtmlSanitizer
classes.description: Provides methods to sanitize HTML content, configure purification settings, and maintain singleton instance for HTML sanitization tasks.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of HtmlSanitizer, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: cleanHtml
methods.description: Sanitizes the given HTML string to prevent XSS, optionally removing HTML tags.

methods.name: stripTags
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from the input HTML string, decoding and encoding as necessary.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Performs HTML sanitization using HTMLPurifier, with special handling for email address encoding.

methods.name: applyConfigs
methods.description: Merges base and extra configuration options into the HTMLPurifier configuration object.
